item.title: SEMICON India 2026 targets full chip value chain
item.summary: India is stepping up its semiconductor ambitions as it moves from attracting major investments to building a broader domestic ecosystem spanning chip design, manufacturing, packaging, equipment, materials, R&D and skills development.
